episodes.title: Tears of a Dragon
episodes.summary: After harshly rebuking her assistant, Cho Sam-dal becomes embroiled in a scandal and faces severe blowback — forcing her to return to her hometown.

episodes.title: The Soulmate's History
episodes.summary: While moping over her career downfall, Sam-dal awkwardly encounters Cho Yong-pil. She later runs into him again — where she must come to his rescue.

episodes.title: LIke Wild Birds, Soaring, Dreaming, Descending
episodes.summary: Sam-dal avoids being seen in public as more people find out about her arrival. But she overhears a hurtful conversation, causing her to break down.

episodes.title: The Rotten Apple of My Eye
episodes.summary: As the townspeople talk, Sam-dal sets the record straight to her community. Ashamed by the truth, Sam-dal lies to Yong-pil about her love life.

episodes.title: I See You
episodes.summary: As Yong-pil shows concern for Sam-dal, she confronts him about his insistence. When a reporter shows up to Sam-dal's town, her friends go to bat for her.

episodes.title: "The Dreams" by Cho Yong-pil
episodes.summary: Yong-pil finds competition in Bu Sang-do for Sam-dal's love. Sam-dal finds out about Bang Eun-ju's scheme and heads to Seoul to find out the truth.

episodes.title: Breaking Up, With Love
episodes.summary: Sang-do confronts Yong-pil about their shared feelings for Sam-dal. Sam-dal's mother begins to suspect something is happening between Sam-dal and Yong-pil.

episodes.title: The Bracken Rain of Jeju
episodes.summary: Ko Mi-ja experiences a frightening moment during a dive amid lingering health problems. After much encouragement, Sam-dal enters a photo competition.

episodes.title: The Story of the Two Mi-jas
episodes.summary: As Mi-ja's condition remains dire, Sam-dal learns she's been unaware about her mother's health — and that Yong-pil's been more present than she'd known.

episodes.title: The Variables We Couldn't Predict
episodes.summary: After a drunken night, Sam-dal agonizes over a tender moment with Yong-pil. But they soon are forced to take a trip around Jeju for the photo contest.

episodes.title: What Doesn't Kill You Makes You Stronger
episodes.summary: A man from Cho Jin-dal's past angers her family with an ill-advised announcement. Sam-dal continues to agonize over her feelings toward Yong-pil.

episodes.title: Welcome Home
episodes.summary: Sam-dal worries about her mother's perception as her relationship with Yong-pil's grows. After uploading a video of Sam-dal, Eun-ju comes to Samdal-ri.

episodes.title: That Damn One-sided Love
episodes.summary: Just as Yong-pil and Sam-dal get closer, his father harshly rebukes them. Amid the tension, Mi-ja finally stands up for herself — and the past.

episodes.title: When Your Tears Dry Out
episodes.summary: After becoming official, Sam-dal and Yong-pil go off on a shoot — but they're joined by guests. Sam-dal later attempts to win over Yong-pil's father.

episodes.title: It Takes a Village to Raise a Dragon
episodes.summary: Eun-ju plants a story about Sam-dal, complicating her role in the photo contest. But Sam-dal's community bands together to aid in her exhibition.

episodes.title: Welcome to Samdalri
episodes.summary: As Eun-ju's lies catch up to her, Sam-dal hosts her exhibition. She later finds out about Yong-pil's secret dream — and his hesitation about pursuing it.
